title: Lifting a machine action
statement: Let an action of a $K$-work-tape machine act on a configuration with fixed input, and extend the configuration by one work tape whose contents are a function $M\colon\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and whose head is at position $p$. Extend the action by leaving this additional tape unwritten and stationary. Applying the extended action to the extended configuration gives the extension, by the same $M$ and $p$, of the configuration obtained by applying the original action.
hypotheses_covered: a natural number $K$, state type, and fixed input bit string
an additional tape content function $M\colon\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and head position $p\in\mathbb Z$
